parts.description: A white ceramic bowl with a wide rim and a subtle speckled texture.
parts.reasoning: Based on the visual appearance (matte, slightly textured white surface with fine speckles), the material is estimated to be ceramic or stoneware. A standard pasta/soup bowl of this style has a diameter of roughly 22-25cm and a thickness of ~5mm. The mass is estimated at 0.55 kg, which aligns with standard ceramic density (approx. 2400 kg/m³). Friction values (static 0.45, dynamic 0.35) are typical for unglazed or matte ceramic on common table surfaces. Restitution is kept low (0.15) as ceramic is highly rigid and absorbs energy on impact rather than bouncing. Crucially for simulation in Isaac Sim, the collision geometry must use 'convex_decomposition' rather than 'convex_hull'; a convex hull would create a flat plane across the top of the bowl, preventing objects from being placed inside it.
